title: Depth bound for recursive circuit combination
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $b$ specify an AND or OR gate, and let $cs$ be a finite list of Boolean circuit trees on $n$ variables. For every natural number $k$ with $|cs|\le k$, the circuit obtained by recursively combining the list with fuel $k$ has depth at most the maximum depth in $cs$ plus $\operatorname{clog}_2(|cs|)+1$, where the maximum over an empty list is $0$.
hypotheses_covered: $cs$ is a finite list of circuits on $n$ variables
